name: Bloat

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, inputs, the sidebar and the tab bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative separators and card borders. Never the only boundary of an input.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, the main action fill, selected options and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary readable text (6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Selected navigation, neutral banners, quiet fills.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs and unselected options (3.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Alias of ink for the one primary action per task region. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Alias of subtle for quiet fills.

tokens.name: score-mild
tokens.usage: Strength and Bloat Score 1-3 marks, with a control outline. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: score-moderate
tokens.usage: Score 4-6 marks. Text on it: ink (9:1).

tokens.name: score-strong
tokens.usage: Score 7-8 marks. Text on it: on-score-strong.

tokens.name: score-severe
tokens.usage: Score 9-10 marks. Text on it: on-score-severe.

tokens.name: on-score
tokens.usage: Labels on mild and moderate marks.

tokens.name: on-score-strong
tokens.usage: Labels on strong marks (6:1).

tokens.name: on-score-severe
tokens.usage: Labels on severe marks.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The one semantic colour, kept from version 1: only the NHS warning signs and their advice (always with an icon and text), and destructive actions.

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected warning sign and its advice box.

styles.name: score-number
styles.usage: The big number, tabular figures, with '/ 10' beside it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, options, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, the Pro label, score marks and progress bars.

note: Bloat / Silver, approved by the owner on 19 Nov 2026 (docs/design/silver/). Supersedes version 1 (green, Bricolage Grotesque and DM Sans, pill controls, light and dark). Light theme only for now: see DECISIONS.md, Engineering choice 21.
